encode_rANS_messages: build a python module to encode batched messages into compressed bytes using the rANS entropy coder with a CrayCodec
decode_rANS_messages: build a python module to decode compressed bytes back into batched messages using the rANS entropy coder with a CrayCodec
encode_with_existing_buffers: build a python module to append encoded messages to existing compressed buffers using the encode function with start_buffers
review_encode_function: review the encode function to understand how it handles batched interleaved rANS encoding with tail capacity management
